title: Trump’s Immigration Policy Echoes 1920s Crackdown, but This Time Congress Isn’t Involved
summary: U.S. leaders limited immigration amid economic and social turmoil. Historians see similarities to Trump’s crackdown, with a catch: He’s doing it without Congress.
